title: 第7章 祸水东引第8章 触发机缘顿悟暴击
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
………………
只见。
小灵将目光投向白鸿飞。
娇声开口：“既然你不相信，那我就把你们俩写的分别念出来，让你输个明白！”
话音落下。
小灵缓缓开口。
将两人写的诗词给念了出来。
……
随着小灵话音落下。
整个天香楼瞬间陷入了安静之中，众人脸上露出了震惊的表情。
目光不由投向了江尘。
“明月几时有？把酒问青天。”
“不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。”
众人细细品味着。
“绝笔，真乃绝笔也！”
“是啊，怪不得明月小姐会邀请江尘公子入内一叙，这次我输得心服口服。”
……
白鸿飞整个人也呆在了原地，目光中满是不可思议之色，拳头不由紧握在了一起。
江尘：“麻烦让一让！”
听到江尘再次开口。

白鸿飞脸色变得更加阴沉。
但察觉到众人的目光后。
他只能憋屈的移开了身体。
把路给让了出来。
不过。
白鸿飞眼眸中充满了杀意，垂落的双拳更是紧捏在了一起。
江尘淡漠的扫视了白鸿飞一眼。
迈步朝小灵所在位置走去。
小灵：“江公子，请！”
在小灵的带领下。
江尘缓慢走进了包厢之中，让他有些意外的是，这包厢竟别有洞天。
小灵带着他穿过了一个密道，竟出现在天香阁后山，在正前方出现一个小阁楼，阁楼下则是有一个不大的亭子。
配合上周围安静的环境。
颇有一种世外桃源的感觉。
……
content_en:
………………
I saw.
Xiaoling turned his attention to Bai Hongfei.
She said softly: "Since you don't believe it, then I will read out what you two wrote separately so that you can understand clearly!"
The words fell.
Xiao Ling spoke slowly.
He read out the poems written by the two of them.
…
As Xiaoling finished speaking.
The entire Tianxiang Tower fell into silence instantly, with shocked expressions on everyone's faces.
His eyes couldn't help but turn to Jiang Chen.
"When will the bright moon come? Ask the sky for wine."
"I wonder what year it is today in the palace in the sky."
Everyone tasted it carefully.
"A masterpiece, truly a masterpiece!"
"Yes, no wonder Miss Mingyue would invite Mr. Jiang Chen inside to talk. This time I am convinced that I lost."
…
Bai Hongfei also stayed on the spot, his eyes full of disbelief, and his fists could not help but clenched together.
Jiang Chen: "Please give way!"
I heard Jiang Chen speak again.
Bai Hongfei's face became even more gloomy.
But after noticing everyone's gaze.
He could only move away in frustration.
Make way for him.
but.
Bai Hongfei's eyes were filled with murderous intent, and his lowered fists were clenched tightly together.
Jiang Chen glanced at Bai Hongfei indifferently.
He walked towards Xiao Ling's location.
Xiaoling: "Mr. Jiang, please!"
Under the leadership of Xiaoling.
Jiang Chen slowly walked into the box. What surprised him was that this box was actually unique.
Xiao Ling led him through a secret passage and appeared in the back mountain of Tianxiang Pavilion. There was a small attic directly in front, and there was a small pavilion under the attic.
Couple it with the quiet environment around you.
It has quite a feeling of paradise.
…
